title: Recommendation check
summary: Checks the memo's recommendation against an options-by-criteria matrix built by independent reviewers, with the conditions that would change it. The decision-maker's choice is recorded at the checkpoint.

values.label: Recommendation supported by the options matrix
Recommendation departs from the matrix (reason given or missing)

notes: Value trade-offs and political feasibility belong to the decision-maker; stakeholder positions are reported as stated.

inputs.label: The decision to be made
inputs.help: State the decision the memo asks for.

inputs.label: A deadline
inputs.help: State when the decision is needed and why.

inputs.label: At least two options plus the status quo
inputs.help: Set out at least two options and the status quo.

inputs.label: Stated criteria
inputs.help: State the criteria the options are judged on.

config.instructions: List each option (including the status quo) and each criterion the memo states.

fields.name: kind
fields.label: Kind
fields.description: Whether it is an option or a criterion

fields.name: id
fields.label: Id
fields.description: A short id: O1, O2… for options, C1, C2… for criteria

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: What it is, in a sentence

fields.name: is_status_quo
fields.label: Status quo
fields.description: For an option: whether it is the status quo or no-action option

checklist.label: Criteria defined apart from the options
checklist.question: Are the criteria defined apart from the options (not written to favour one)?

checklist.label: No criterion only one option can meet
checklist.question: Is there a criterion only one option can meet? Name it.

checklist.label: Options have authority, budget and time
checklist.question: Does any option lack the authority, budget or time to carry it out? Name it.

config.instructions: List one cell per option and criterion the memo assesses: what the memo claims about that option on that criterion, and the evidence it gives. Include the status quo. Skip pairs the memo says nothing about.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Cell
fields.description: The option and criterion, as “Option — Criterion”

fields.name: claim
fields.label: Claim
fields.description: What the memo says about the option on this criterion

fields.name: stated_evidence
fields.label: Stated evidence
fields.description: The evidence or estimate the memo gives for it, if any

config.question: Is the memo's claim for this cell backed by a linked source (supported), a stated estimate or projection (estimated), or nothing (unsupported)?
config.instructions: Judge the evidence for each cell, not whether the option is good. Mark estimated when the memo gives a projection or estimate without a source behind it.
Rate each option against each criterion with a rationale. In each rationale say whether the evidence for the cell is supported by a source, estimated, or unsupported. Use unknown rather than guess.

reviewers.label: Case builder
reviewers.brief: Build the strongest honest case for each option in turn, citing the evidence that favours it on each criterion.

reviewers.label: Skeptic
reviewers.brief: For each option, find the costs, risks and disconfirming evidence on each criterion, including what the memo leaves out.

checklist.label: Robust to priority order
checklist.question: Using the agreed options matrix, does the recommendation change under a different priority order of the criteria? Name the conditions.

checklist.label: Robust to the least certain estimate
checklist.question: Using the agreed options matrix, does the recommendation change if the least certain cell or estimate moves? Name the cell and the conditions.

config.instructions: Work from the agreed options matrix (the reviewer agreement table in <data>): vary the priority order of the criteria and the least certain cells, and say which conditions would change the recommendation.

checklist.label: Recommendation matches the matrix
checklist.question: Does the memo's recommendation match the agreed options matrix (the reviewer agreement table in <data>), or does the memo say why it departs?

checklist.label: Recommendation first
checklist.question: Does the memo put the recommendation first, then options, risks, cost and next steps?

checklist.label: Status quo present
checklist.question: Is the status quo present as an option?

checklist.label: Costs for every option
checklist.question: Are costs given for every option, not one only?

config.guidance: Begin the rationale with “Recommended option: ” and the option the memo recommends, by name. supported when the recommendation matches the agreed options matrix; departs when it does not (say whether the memo gives a reason); incomplete_matrix when the status quo, at least two options or stated criteria are missing, or many cells are unknown or unsupported. Name the conditions that would change the recommendation.

config.instructions: Record your decision: approve the recommendation, choose another option, defer, or ask for more.

recordFields.label: Approve recommendation / chose another option / defer / asked for more
